product.description: Simplify your cleaning routine with just the essentials—our four bestsellers in home cleaning kit. From dirty hands to dirty surfaces, keep your home clean and your family safe with 100% plastic-free tablets. Clean Ingredients: Microplastic-free formulas made with plant and mineral-based cleaning power so they’re safe for use around everyone in the family. Cradle to Cradle Certified™, Leaping Bunny (cruelty free), and EPA Safer Choice NEW Dye-Free Spray Cleaner Formula: We heard your feedback! Our spray cleaners are now formulated without dyes. Powerfully Effective: Tried, tested and proven to perform alongside major brands 25% Kit Savings: Get everything in one kit to save money and emissions
sellingPoints: Four refillable bottles with four cleaning tablets
Add warm water, drop a tablet, let it dissolve
Foaming hand soap, multi-surface, bathroom, glass and mirror cleaning
Refill existing bottles instead of replacing the bottle

faq.question: How do I prepare the cleaner?
faq.answer: Fill with warm water to the indicated line. Drop in a tablet, let it dissolve, and replace the nozzle.
